description: Phase 4+5+6+7: API design, edge layer, frontend, and infrastructure fixes. Covers findings M-10, C-6, M-15, M-11, M-12, M-13, M-3, M-4, M-5, M-6.
steps: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py: Add paginated endpoints - GET /history with skip/limit params and GET /{session_id}/messages with skip/limit. Use Depends(get_current_user) for history and get_current_user_optional for messages. This fixes M-10.

In apps/edge/src/middleware/jwt.ts: Remove '/api/v1/chat' from PUBLIC_PATHS. Add OPTIONAL_AUTH_PATHS array containing '/api/v1/chat'. Also add '/api/v1/auth/forgot-password' and '/api/v1/auth/reset-password' to PUBLIC_PATHS. Modify verifyJWT to check OPTIONAL_AUTH_PATHS: if request matches and has no auth header, return valid/anonymous; if has auth header, validate it normally. This fixes C-6.

In apps/edge/wrangler.toml: Remove the production AZURE_BACKEND_URL from [env.production.vars] section. Change the base [vars] AZURE_BACKEND_URL to 'http://localhost:8000'. Add a comment that production URL should be set via 'npx wrangler secret put AZURE_BACKEND_URL --env production'. This fixes M-15.

In apps/frontend/src/lib/supabase.js: Add a detailed JSDoc comment block explaining the Supabase-to-backend JWT auth bridge flow (OAuth redirect -> Supabase token -> POST /api/v1/auth/google -> backend JWT). This fixes M-11.
In apps/frontend/package.json: Remove 'firebase' from dependencies. This fixes M-12.

Replace apps/frontend/src/utils/firebasePerf.js with a web-vitals-only implementation that exports the same API surface (initFirebasePerf becomes no-op, startTrace returns stub, reportWebVitalToPerf uses console/PostHog, makeTraceparent stays). This removes the Firebase dependency while maintaining the interface. This fixes M-12.

In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py: Add a POST /google endpoint (GoogleAuthRequest model with supabase_token field) that would verify the Supabase token and create/find user. Add SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY as Optional[str] = None fields in config.py. This completes M-11 backend side.

Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin.py: Add GET /verify endpoint that checks syrabit_admin_session cookie, verifies it as a JWT with type=admin and role=admin. This fixes M-13. Register it in main.py.
In apps/backend/Dockerfile: Remove the line 'COPY --from=builder /usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages /usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages'. This fixes M-3.

In docker-compose.yml: Add redis-rest service using hiett/serverless-redis-http:latest image. Change backend UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL to 'http://redis-rest:80'. Add UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN=local_dev_token. Make backend depend on redis-rest. This fixes M-4.

Create infra/azure/search-index.bicep with Azure Search resource definition (param location, sku, semanticRankerEnabled). Create infra/azure/container-app.bicep with Container App + Log Analytics + Environment resources. This fixes M-5.

Create infra/azure/shared-resources.bicep with storageAccount and keyVault resources. Update infra/azure/main.bicep: remove direct storageAccount and keyVault resource declarations, add 'module sharedResources ./shared-resources.bicep' with scope: resourceGroup. Add outputs. This fixes M-6.
acceptance_criteria: chat.py has GET /history and GET /{session_id}/messages endpoints with pagination
jwt.ts has OPTIONAL_AUTH_PATHS with /api/v1/chat and PUBLIC_PATHS without /api/v1/chat
wrangler.toml does not have hardcoded production AZURE_BACKEND_URL in vars
supabase.js has detailed JSDoc explaining auth bridge flow
package.json does not include firebase dependency
firebasePerf.js no longer imports from firebase/* packages
main.bicep uses modules for storage and keyvault instead of direct resources
All modified Python files pass py_compile
findings: All 13 changes implemented successfully. Python files pass py_compile. Firebase removed from package.json (grep count = 0). site-packages line removed from Dockerfile. OPTIONAL_AUTH_PATHS added to edge JWT middleware. All infra Bicep modules created and main.bicep refactored.
